about.title: A propos de nous
about.content-p1: Spade Diamonds, it's a family affair. A project started in 2008 with the initial sole purpose of playing “la fête de la musique” in Meaux, where they are based. This lead to numerous musical projects: The first musical contest win in 2009, the first EP in 2010, and a series of concerts throughout Paris and neighbouring cities, including venues such as le File7, l'espace Caravalle, le Gibus, le Truskel and Les Disquaires.
about.content-p2: Spade Diamonds it's also a sound. British-rock based, French pop infused and classical musically coated, Spade Diamonds' sound evolves with freedom between several universe, and becomes whole on stage where it is delivered with passion and intensity.
